title: 生物风险评估六步走（国内版）
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/43_How do you perform a Biorisk assessment biorisk assessment biosafety trending.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/43_How do you perform a Biorisk assessment biorisk assessment biosafety trending（国内版）/src.py

points.S1: 评估小组：让动手的人参与
points.S2: 把操作拆成小步，找暴露点
points.S3: 风险矩阵：可能性和后果一起看

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一块空白剪贴板，上面有生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank clipboard with a small biohazard symbol and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：生物风险评估怎么做。

shots.scene: 阿杰兴冲冲拿着一管样本走向离心机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student eagerly walks toward a centrifuge carrying a closed sample tube.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿到新菌株，想马上开始实验。

shots.scene: 老周伸手拦住，递给他空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The older man raises a hand to stop him and hands him a blank assessment form.
shots.narration: 老周拦下他：先做风险评估。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着空白表格发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at the blank form, puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰：评估从哪儿下手？

shots.scene: 小研拉过一把椅子坐到阿杰旁边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls up a chair and sits beside him with a pen.
shots.narration: 小研：按六步来，一步一步填。

shots.scene: 六个台阶，每级一个图标
shots.prompt_en: Six steps in a row, each with an icon: a magnifier, a dice, a gauge, a shield, a folder and a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 生物风险评估有固定步骤，按顺序走。

shots.scene: 第六级台阶的循环箭头亮起
shots.prompt_en: The sixth step with a circular arrow icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 最后一步是复查，走完还要回头看。

shots.section_title: 评估小组：让动手的人参与
shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰围坐桌边，王老师走过来
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student sit around a table; the safety administrator joins them.
shots.narration: 评估不是一个人填表。
overlay: 评估小组：让动手的人参与

shots.section_title: 评估小组：让动手的人参与
shots.scene: 阿杰在纸上画出自己每天怎么操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sketches his daily workflow as simple boxes on blank paper.
shots.narration: 真正动手的人最清楚哪里容易出错。

shots.section_title: 评估小组：让动手的人参与
shots.scene: 老周点头签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man nods and signs at the bottom of the blank form.
shots.narration: 负责人组织，操作者参与，大家一起看。

shots.scene: 放大镜照在培养皿和移液器上
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass hovers over a petri dish and a pipette on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，危害识别。

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白封面的目录，指着一行
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a catalogue book with a blank cover and points to a line.
shots.narration: 先弄清用的是什么生物因子，查国内目录。

shots.scene: 三个图标：试管、离心机、动物笼
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a test tube rack, a centrifuge and an animal cage. No people.
shots.narration: 再列出要做哪些实验活动。

shots.scene: 量杯图标从小到大
shots.prompt_en: Three beakers from small to large with a rising arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 用量多少、浓度多高，也要写清楚。

shots.section_title: 把操作拆成小步，找暴露点
shots.scene: 一条流程线拆成五个小方框
shots.prompt_en: A workflow line split into five small boxes in a row: open tube, pipette, mix, spin, discard. No people.
shots.narration: 把整个操作拆成一个个小步骤，
overlay: 把操作拆成小步，找暴露点

shots.section_title: 把操作拆成小步，找暴露点
shots.scene: 四个暴露途径图标：雾滴、针头、飞溅、手
shots.prompt_en: Four exposure route icons: a mist cloud, a needle, a splash drop and a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步问：会不会产生气溶胶？

shots.section_title: 把操作拆成小步，找暴露点
shots.scene: 流程方框中两个变成红色
shots.prompt_en: Two of the five workflow boxes turn red with small warning triangles. No people.
shots.narration: 有没有锐器、溅洒、手接触？标出风险点。

shots.scene: 骰子图标和破碎的盾牌图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon next to a cracked shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，风险分析。

shots.scene: 小研指着骰子：出事的可能性有多大
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a large dice icon on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 估计发生暴露的可能性有多大，

shots.scene: 人体轮廓图标，旁边轻重两个刻度
shots.prompt_en: A human outline next to a scale bar from light to severe. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦暴露，后果有多严重。

shots.section_title: 风险矩阵：可能性和后果一起看
shots.scene: 白板上三乘三的空格矩阵，颜色从绿到红
shots.prompt_en: A three-by-three grid on a whiteboard, colored from green in one corner to red in the opposite corner, cells blank. No people.
shots.narration: 可以把两者放进风险矩阵一起看。
overlay: 风险矩阵：可能性和后果一起看

shots.section_title: 风险矩阵：可能性和后果一起看
shots.scene: 一个圆点落在矩阵右上红格
shots.prompt_en: A dot is placed in the red corner cell of the grid. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性大、后果重，就落在红格。

shots.section_title: 风险矩阵：可能性和后果一起看
shots.scene: 阿杰把各步骤的圆点贴到矩阵上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places several dots on the grid on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 每个风险点都放上去，一目了然。

shots.scene: 仪表盘指针在低、中、高之间摆动
shots.prompt_en: A gauge with three colored zones, green, yellow and red; the needle moves between them. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，风险评价。

shots.scene: 指针停在黄色区
shots.prompt_en: The gauge needle stops in the yellow zone. No people.
shots.narration: 给出总体风险等级：低、中还是高。

shots.scene: 老周看着仪表，思考
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks thoughtfully at the gauge on the whiteboard.
shots.narration: 等级决定要采取多强的措施。

shots.scene: 盾牌图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A large shield icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步，风险控制。

shots.scene: 三个图标：安全柜、手套护目镜、空白规程本
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a biosafety cabinet, gloves with goggles and a blank procedure binder. No people.
shots.narration: 选用工程控制、个人防护和标准规程。

shots.scene: 阿杰把离心管放进带盖的离心转子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places tubes into a centrifuge rotor with a sealed safety lid.
shots.narration: 比如离心用密封转子，在柜里开盖。

shots.scene: 仪表指针从黄区退回绿区
shots.prompt_en: The gauge needle moves back from yellow to green. No people.
shots.narration: 措施到位，把风险降下来。

shots.scene: 文件夹图标打开
shots.prompt_en: A folder icon opens. No people.
shots.narration: 第五步，记录。

shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上写字，老周签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on the blank assessment form and the older man signs it.
shots.narration: 把评估过程和控制措施写下来，

shots.scene: 评估表放进实验室的文件柜
shots.prompt_en: The completed blank form is filed in a lab document cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 存档备查，新来的人也能看到。

shots.scene: 循环箭头图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第六步，复查。

shots.scene: 三个触发图标：新微生物、新流程、事故警示
shots.prompt_en: Three trigger icons: a new microbe with a star, a new workflow chart and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 换了病原、改了流程、出了事件，

shots.scene: 小研重新打开文件夹修改评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes the form out of the folder and revises it.
shots.narration: 都要重新评估，及时更新。

shots.scene: 日历图标，几个月后有一个圆圈
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a circle marked a few months later. No people.
shots.narration: 没有变化，也要定期复查。

shots.scene: 王老师接过评估表，盖章图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator receives the form and a stamp icon appears.
shots.narration: 新实验的防护级别，报委员会审批。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在六级台阶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the six steps with their icons.
shots.narration: 识别、分析、评价、控制、记录、复查。

shots.scene: 操作流程拆成小方框，红点标出
shots.prompt_en: A workflow split into small boxes, two marked red. No people.
shots.narration: 拆开步骤找暴露点。

shots.scene: 三乘三矩阵
shots.prompt_en: The green-to-red three-by-three grid. No people.
shots.narration: 用矩阵看可能性和后果。

shots.scene: 一群人围坐桌边
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student sit together around a table with a blank form.
shots.narration: 动手的人参与，评估才靠谱。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰举着签好的空白表格挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye, holding a signed blank form.
shots.narration: 先评估，再动手，下次见！
